reason: I go to a freelancer I already trust or someone who's been referred to me, and I'm accountable for every dollar. A new platform paid in USDC on Solana, run by one person, not audited, is a lot for me to explain to my board.
objection: Can an AI judge really tell good work from bad for my taste and brand? If it picks the wrong winner I still have to defend the spend, and I'd have to figure out USDC on top of that.
would_change_my_mind: A colleague at another organisation I trust telling me they used it and got work they were happy with, plus a way to pay by card or invoice and a human who signs off on the winner.
